name: @telebook/cli
description: TeleBook CLI tool for Jupyter Notebook hosting and syncing

scripts.test: if [ -x ../../.venv/bin/pytest ]; then ../../.venv/bin/pytest tests; elif python3 -c 'import pytest, telebook' >/dev/null 2>&1; then pytest tests; else echo 'Python test dependencies not installed; skipping @telebook/cli Python tests in Node runner'; fi
